job_description:
Software Engineer In Test

Phenomenal opportunity for a Software Engineer/Senior Software Engineer in test with strong software development talent. This individual will be responsible for crafting and developing test automation and inhouse software utilities as part of the Quality Engineering organization within the Workplace Investing division. This role is based in multiple locations Westlake, TX, Raleigh, NC and Smithfield, RI. Fully Remote!

The Expertise and Skills You Bring:
• B.S. Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar technical field.
• 5-8 years of test automation development using Python or similar language.
• Experience in testing distributed applications at multiple layers of the technology stack.
• Experience working with Behave Framework.
• Experience using REST, Python, Web Services, SOAP, Git, Jenkins.
• Experience with test automation tools, Cucumber, Selenium, RESTAssured, Git and Jenkins.
• Hands on experience with crafting and maintaining testing frameworks like Junit, TestRunner, Selenium (TestNG).
• Knowledge of Version Control Systems (Git, ClearCase etc.)
• Proven technical skills (e.g. SQL, XML, HTML, JavaScript, Java, or Python).
• Demonstrated experience in DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
• Have the proven ability to work independently as part of an Agile Sprint, Kanban team/squads.
• Experience with agile methodology and tool sets (JIRA).
• Ability to quickly learn and apply new technical skills.
• Ability to work effectively on a globally dispersed team.

The Team:

As part of the Workplace Investing Quality Engineering team has an opening for Software Engineer/Senior Software Engineer in test. You will join a Scrum team of 6-8 highly talented individuals. You will have a pivotal role on project delivery teams – developing and testing the critical application that diligently test our products and instill confidence in capabilities. You will be joining a larger Quality Engineering team, using innovative testing techniques to test applications.

Required Skills: Cucumber, ETL, Python, SQL, Behave Framework, Snowflake

Basic Qualification: Additional Skills: Background Check: Yes Drug Screen: Yes Notes: Python and Behave Framework are required skills candidates need to have! Upon offer, client requires 5 years of W2s for US projects (where applicable) to validate consultant's work history. It is required to show consultants W2 take home pay in the Exh A.
